findings_text: Current registry broadly corresponds to TM healthcare-worker trial: 80 participants, randomized open-label, self-reported stress primary at baseline/one/three months; outcome description identifies BSI-18. First posted 2020-11-17 before registered start 2020-11-20 (paper starts 2020-11-19). Primary distress result remains nonsignificant. Historical versions and full statistical plan not independently reconciled; current correspondence does not prove prespecification.

Current registry lists NON_RANDOMIZED allocation while article abstract calls randomized; registry masking description itself refers to random numbers and assignment by a third person. Sixty participants and pain CPOT primary correspond. First posted 2024-07-30 before listed start 2024-08-10. Allocation/masking contradiction requires registry-history and full-paper reconciliation; do not validate an RCT label from abstract alone.

Current registry randomized participant-masked three-arm study with seven primary outcome measures. Enrollment 66 versus paper abstract 65. First submitted 2022-07-29 and posted 2022-08-02 after listed completion 2022-07-25; retrospectively registered. Clarify denominator and multiplicity; cortisol changes in both Reiki and sham do not establish Reiki-specific physiology.

Current registry randomized open-label Kirtan Kriya/music trial, cognitive outcomes primary. Enrollment 36 versus article randomized count 31 and analyzed biomarker count 25; denominators require flow reconciliation. Posted 2018-10-04 after listed start 2018-09-28. Published biomarker panel differs from current listed inflammatory panel; assess amendments/history before claiming outcome switching. Two articles report one cohort.

Generic spiritual-healing depression feasibility trial, planned 28 participants; feasibility primary and depression scales secondary. First posted 2021-02-23 before estimated start 2021-03-01; current status UNKNOWN with stale last-known not-yet-recruiting. Named Spiritualist lineage unconfirmed. Registry does not establish that symptom outcomes were primary or the intervention effective; protocol/results are linked reports.

Current registry lists randomized, unmasked Polarity/massage study, actual enrollment 45, fatigue primary. First posted 2006-02-08 after listed January-2006 start. Structured intervention model SINGLE_GROUP conflicts with publication's three-arm comparison and registry arm descriptions. Current record only; resolve historical changes, dose/endpoints and model inconsistency. Published primary BFI result remains nonsignificant.
